title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G):
summary: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G): — Flagship scheme comprehensively covered in the Government Schemes Consolidated Masterfile.

blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: o Objective: "Housing for All by 2024" with a target of 2.95 crore houses in rural areas.
o Launch: 20th November 2016, revamped from Indira Awas Yojana (IAY).
o Beneficiaries: ST/SC, Widows, Divyang, Minorities, Free Bonded Labour, Kin of Martyrs, based
 Rs. 1.20 lakh (plain areas), Rs. 1.30 lakh (hilly areas).
o Labor Remuneration: Rs. 19,800 under MNREGA for 90 days.
o House Size: Minimum 25 square meters.
o Rajasthan Progress: 16 lakh houses completed out of 17 lakh eligible families.
o Phase-II: 2 crore additional houses to be built.
